title: The special
summary: The chip shop by the ground has named a meal after you: chips, gravy, a pickled egg and a battered sausage cut into your shirt number. The local paper wants your review. A season on, it's still on the board.

ends.title: On the board
ends.text: There's a meal named after you at the chip shop by the ground. You said it was the best thing you'd ever eaten. It isn't. It's still on the board.

ends.title: Off the board
ends.text: The chip shop took your meal off the board after you said what you thought of the pickled egg. They named it after the goalkeeper instead.

beats.title: The special

event.title: The special
event.speaker: reporter
setup: The chip shop by the ground has a new board: THE {you.short} SPECIAL. Chips, gravy, a pickled egg, and a battered sausage cut to make your shirt number. {reporter.name} from the {reporter.outlet} has brought you one, with a photographer.

say: "One bite for the camera, then your honest review. Out of ten." The pickled egg is looking at you.

replies.label: Eat the egg first, whole, for the camera.

ten.text: "TEN OUT OF TEN" goes in the window. The queue goes round the corner on match days.

honest.text: The owner reads it and takes the egg off. Then takes your name off. It's THE GOALKEEPER SPECIAL by Friday.

egg.text: The photo of your face is on the front page. The owner frames it. It sells more eggs than anything ever has.

beats.hint: The local paper wants a taste test

beats.title: The queue

event.title: The queue
event.speaker: reporter
setup: Since the paper's review there's a queue out of the chip shop door on Friday nights, all of them asking for THE {you.short} SPECIAL. The owner rings you. He's run out of pickled eggs.

say: "Would you come and serve one? Just one. For the paper. {reporter.short} says she'll come."

serve.text: You serve forty-one. {reporter.short}'s photo of you with a scoop goes on the front.

no.text: He sends round a bag of chips anyway.

beats.hint: There's a queue at the chip shop

beats.title: The board

event.title: The board
event.speaker: reporter
setup: A season on. Walking past the chip shop to the ground, you look at the board.
{if arc.deep=='serve'}The photo of you with the scoop is still on the chip shop wall.{/if}

outcomes.text: Still there, top of the board, with a gold star stuck on it. The owner waves a spatula at you.
THE GOALKEEPER SPECIAL. With an egg.
He won't let you pay. The queue claps when you eat the egg.
You order the goalkeeper special. It's very good. Don't tell him.
